These figures come from **Table 1 ("Statistics")** on **page 115**. The scanned text is partly garbled, so I've noted where the printed values look wrong.

| Item | As printed in the scan | Likely correct value |
|---|---|---|
| Total size of fetched pages | 117.8 GB | 117.8 GB (cannot be checked; see below) |
| Compressed repository | "5.33 GB" | **53.5 GB** |
| Lexicon | "203 MB" | **293 MB** |

**Why I think two values are misread**

- **Compressed repository:** Table 1 gives "Total with repository" as 108.7 GB and "Total without repository" as 55.2 GB (p. 115). The difference is 53.5 GB, so "5.33 GB" is almost certainly a misread of 53.5 GB.
- **Lexicon:** The other parts of the "without repository" total add up to 54.9 GB (p. 115):
  - short inverted index: 4.1 GB
  - full inverted index: 37.2 GB
  - document index: 9.7 GB
  - links database: 3.9 GB

  Adding 293 MB gives 55.2 GB, which matches the printed total. Adding 203 MB would give only about 55.1 GB. So the lexicon is most likely 293 MB.
- **Fetched pages:** The document contains nothing else to check the 117.8 GB figure against, so I can only report it as printed. The scan may have garbled this number too.
